verdict.rationale: AMD documents a 16-core, 32-thread design. Independent reviews corroborate multi-core performance: TechPowerUp says it has the best application performance, beating even the 9950X; Tom's Hardware cites strong productivity performance and AVX-512 support; and a Hacker News thread highlights excellent performance for Linux developers. Missing for 10: documented base/boost clock specs and boost behavior under all-core load (only a Precision Boost Overdrive mention), and quantified compile-time or multi-core benchmark figures.
